subject: Ciências
description_pt: Relacionar climas regionais aos padrões de circulação atmosférica e oceânica e ao aquecimento desigual causado pela forma e pelos movimentos da Terra.

components.description_pt: Explicar como aquecimento desigual causado pela forma da Terra afeta climas regionais
components.description_en: Explain how unequal heating caused by Earth's shape affects regional climates
components.cc_component_description: Explain how unequal solar heating of Earth's surface drives atmospheric and oceanic circulation patterns

components.description_pt: Desenvolver modelo ilustrando relação entre padrões de circulação global e características climáticas regionais
components.description_en: Develop a model illustrating the relationship between global circulation patterns and regional climate characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Develop a model illustrating the relationship between global circulation patterns and regional climate characteristics

components.description_pt: Analisar como movimentos rotacional e translacional da Terra influenciam distribuição climática
components.description_en: Analyze how Earth's rotational and translational movements influence climate distribution
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the distribution of solar energy among Earth's systems determines global climate patterns

cc_matches.description: Develop and use a model to describe how unequal heating and rotation of the Earth cause patterns of atmospheric and oceanic circulation that determine regional climates.

The foundation for Earth’s global climate systems is the electromagnetic radiation from the sun, as well as its reflection, absorption, storage, and redistribution among the atmosphere, ocean, and land systems, and this energy’s re-radiation into space.
